    (ιK : K →+* ℂ)

          ClassMatchesGalois O ιK hK ιL hι σ a) ∧
      (∀ σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
        ClassMatchesGalois O ιK hK ιL hι σ (Ψ σ)) := by
